about.title: About TrioPizza
about.storyText: Founded in 2018, TrioPizza was born from a passion for bold flavors and the finest seafood. We set out to create the ultimate pizza experience — combining the richness of the sea with the warmth of a fire oven. Today, we are proud to be the go-to destination for seafood pizza lovers across the city.
about.missionText: Our mission is simple: to craft extraordinary pizzas using the freshest seafood, premium ingredients, and our signature fire-oven technique — delivering an unforgettable dining experience with every single slice.
about.visionText: To be the most celebrated seafood pizza restaurant, where every visit feels special, every bite tells a story, and every guest leaves with a craving to return.
about.qualityDesc: Every pizza is baked in our traditional fire oven, giving it that signature golden crust and smoky depth that sets us apart.
about.customerFocusDesc: We source only the freshest shrimp, fish, and seafood daily — because great pizza starts with great ingredients.
about.integrityDesc: No shortcuts, no compromises. Every ingredient on our menu is carefully selected and honestly prepared.
about.innovationDesc: We constantly innovate our recipes and sauces, pushing the boundaries of what a seafood pizza can be.
